title: Starfall
description: Catch gold stars, avoid red shards. Move with arrows/A-D or drag the basket with mouse/touch. Collect shields and hearts. Enter or space retries.

entities.text: ARROWS MOVE   OR DRAG THE BASKET

rules.do: repeat (26) spawn('dot', {x: rand(8,W-8), y: rand(4,H-4), vy: rand(12,32), layer: -1, tags: ['bg','wrap']}); spawn(null, {text: 'CATCH GOLD   DODGE RED', size: 11, x: W / 2, y: 190, layer: -1, stroke: '#4b4070', width: 1.4})

do: let dir = clamp(axis('x') + (held('right') ? 1 : 0) - (held('left') ? 1 : 0),-1,1); self.x = clamp(self.x + dir * 360 * dt,30,W-30)
let a = get('aura'); a.x = self.x; a.opacity = state.shield > 0 ? 0.7+sin(time*8)*0.3 : 0
state.elapsed += dt; state.st -= dt; state.comboT = max(0,state.comboT-dt)

if (state.st <= 0) { let kind = random() < max(0.5,0.78-state.elapsed*0.002) ? 'star' : 'shard'; spawn(kind, {x:rand(30,W-30),y:-16,vy:state.speed*rand(0.9,1.1),vr:rand(-1.8,1.8),tags:[kind,'falling']}); state.st = max(0.45,0.85-state.elapsed*0.004) * rand(0.85,1.15) }

if (state.over) { self.vy=0; self.vr=0 } else { let p = get('player'); if (p && self.y >= p.y-15 && self.y <= p.y+14 && abs(self.x-p.x) <= 30 && !self.data.caught) { self.data.caught = true; emit('hit',{a:p.id,b:self.id,tags:['player',has(self,'star') ? 'star' : (has(self,'shard') ? 'shard' : (has(self,'heart') ? 'heart' : 'shield'))]}) } }; if (self.y > H+24) despawn(self)
despawn(b); state.score += 10 * state.combo; state.combo = min(5,state.combo+1); state.comboT = 4.5; sound('ding')
spawn('spark', {x: b.x, y: b.y, vx: -60, vy: -40, data: {ttl: 0.3}})
spawn('spark', {x: b.x, y: b.y, vx: 60, vy: -40, data: {ttl: 0.3}})

if (state.shield > 0) { state.shield = 0; sound('shield') } else { state.lives -= 1; sound('crack'); spawn(null, {x: b.x, y: b.y, emitter: {shape: 'spark', burst: 10, rate: 0, life: [0.2, 0.5], speed: [80, 200], stroke: '#ff5d73'}, data: {ttl: 0.7}}) }

if (state.lives <= 0) { state.over = true; state.best = max(state.best, state.score); sound('over'); spawn(null, {text: 'GAME OVER', size: 34, x: W / 2, y: 150, stroke: '#ff5d73', width: 3}); spawn(null, {text: 'SCORE ' + str(state.score) + '   PRESS ENTER', size: 11, x: W / 2, y: 190, stroke: '#f2f4f8', width: 1.5}); emit('gameover', {score: state.score}) }

rules.do: state.hud = ''; let s = get('score'); if (s) s.text = 'SCORE ' + str(state.score) + '  BEST ' + str(max(state.best,state.score)); s = get('status'); if (s) s.text = 'LIVES ' + str(state.lives) + (state.shield > 0 ? '  SHIELD' : (state.combo > 1 ? '  X' + str(state.combo) : '')); s = get('help'); if (s) s.text = state.over ? 'ENTER OR SPACE TO RETRY' : 'ARROWS MOVE   OR DRAG THE BASKET'
